# Iqra University GPA Calculator — Full Documentation

> A free, open-source GPA calculator web application designed exclusively for Iqra University (Karachi, Pakistan) students. Built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Features a modern dark glassmorphism UI, real-time SGPA calculations, and secure cloud storage via Instant DB. CGPA tracking across semesters coming soon.

---

## Overview

This is the most accurate GPA calculator for Iqra University students. It uses the official Iqra University grading scale and credit system to compute Semester GPA (SGPA) with 100% accuracy. CGPA (Cumulative GPA) tracking across multiple semesters is planned as a future feature.

**Live URL:** https://gpa-calculator-lyart-ten.vercel.app/

---

## Iqra University Official Grading Scale

| Grade | Grade Point | Description |
|-------|-------------|-------------|
| A     | 4.00        | Excellent   |
| A-    | 3.67        | Very Good   |
| B+    | 3.33        | Good Plus   |
| B     | 3.00        | Good        |
| B-    | 2.67        | Average Plus|
| C+    | 2.33        | Average     |
| C     | 2.00        | Minimum for Degree |
| C-    | 1.67        | Below Average (Probation at 1.70 SGPA) |
| D+    | 1.33        | Poor Plus   |
| D     | 1.00        | Poor        |
| F     | 0.00        | Fail        |

### Academic Rules
- **C (2.00)** is the minimum grade required to pass a course and earn the degree
- **C- (1.67)** triggers academic probation if SGPA falls below 1.70
- Credits are typically 1–4 per course depending on lab/theory load

---

## How GPA is Calculated

### Semester GPA (SGPA)
```
SGPA = Sum(Grade Point × Credit Hours) / Sum(Credit Hours)
```

**Example:**
| Course | Credits | Grade | Grade Point | Quality Points |
|--------|---------|-------|-------------|----------------|
| CS-101 | 3       | A     | 4.00        | 12.00          |
| MT-201 | 4       | B+    | 3.33        | 13.32          |
| EN-101 | 3       | A-    | 3.67        | 11.01          |
| **Total** | **10** | | | **36.33** |

**SGPA = 36.33 / 10 = 3.63**

### Cumulative GPA (CGPA) — Coming Soon
CGPA tracking across multiple semesters is planned as a future update. Currently, each semester's SGPA is calculated independently.

---

## Features

### Core Functionality
- **Unlimited Semesters:** Add as many semesters as you need
- **Unlimited Subjects:** Add any number of subjects per semester
- **Real-Time Calculation:** SGPA updates instantly when you change grades or credits
- **Quality Points:** Auto-calculated as Grade Point × Credits
- **CGPA Tracking:** Coming soon — will compute cumulative GPA across all semesters

### User Experience
- **Dark Glassmorphism UI:** Modern, eye-friendly dark theme with glass effects
- **Mobile-First Design:** Works perfectly on phones, tablets, and desktops
- **Smooth Animations:** Framer Motion powered transitions
- **Instant Feedback:** See your GPA update in real-time

### Account & Data
- **Secure Login:** Magic link authentication (no passwords needed)
- **Cloud Storage:** All data saved securely via Instant DB
- **Private:** Each student's data is completely isolated
- **Persistent:** Your data survives browser refreshes and device switches

## Common Questions

### Q: Is this calculator accurate for Iqra University?
**A:** Yes. It uses the exact Iqra University grading scale published in their official documentation. Every grade point value matches the official scale.

### Q: Can I use this for other universities?
**A:** This is built specifically for Iqra University's grading scale. Other universities may use different scales.

### Q: Is my data safe?
**A:** Yes. Data is stored in Instant DB with owner-only permissions. Only you can see your GPA data. The database enforces strict access control at the server level.

### Q: Does it work on mobile?
**A:** Yes. The app is fully responsive and works great on phones, tablets, and desktops.

### Q: Is it free?
**A:** Completely free. No ads, no subscriptions, no hidden fees.

### Q: How do I calculate my CGPA?
**A:** Simply add all your semesters with their subjects. The app automatically calculates your overall CGPA across all semesters.
